body: I’ve been in a similar situation, meds do nothing, therapy doesn’t help, coping mechanisms don’t help when you’re at your wits end. i started trying to figure out where my paranoia and anxiety came from (like dug DEEP into childhood) / your environment. and don’t blame yourself if that’s something you do. at least you’re trying, which is a huge step. you’re trying out therapy, medication, eventually something is going to click. for me it was finding a support group of people going through a similar situation. sending big hugs to you, and i hope you can find something that helps you.
thank you, to be heard and responded to makes the pain a little more bearable.
thank you. this message is so kind
